# Test fixtures of @pcbjs/kicad

Where the files under this folder come from and under which terms.

- `footprints/*.pretty/*.kicad_mod`: copied unchanged from the KiCad 10.0.6 footprint library as installed with KiCad, https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints, licensed CC-BY-SA 4.0 with the exception that designs using them may be licensed freely, https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/. They cover every pad shape and type KiCad writes: roundrect, trapezoid, custom, chamfered, oval, circle and rect pads, smd, thru_hole, np_thru_hole and connect, round and slotted drills, paste windows and arcs.
- `boards/small/small.kicad_pcb` and `small.kicad_pro`: written by KiCad 10.0.6's pcbnew from `make-small.py` in the same folder, placing the library footprints above; `kicad-fab/` is its Gerber and drill set from kicad-cli 10.0.6, as the script's header says.
- `boards/tabs/`: written by hand as a small synthetic board, `tabs.kicad_pcb`, `.kicad_pro`, `.kicad_dru` and `.kicad_sch`: two slotted tabs, a 1206 resistor and a two pin header on the back, from three footprints of no library, the nets SIG and GND, one arc track, three custom rules and the part numbers. `kicad-fab/` is its copper, mask, paste, outline and drill set from kicad-cli 10.0.6, `kicad-cli pcb export gerbers -l F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,Edge.Cuts,F.Paste --no-protel-ext -o kicad-fab/ tabs.kicad_pcb` and `kicad-cli pcb export drill --excellon-separate-th -o kicad-fab/ tabs.kicad_pcb`, without the empty NPTH file and the job file.
- `boards/roboto-slab-text.kicad_pcb`: written by hand for the font import test, two texts in KiCad's TrueType face "Roboto Slab" bold and one in a face no machine has. The font it is imported with is `packages/core/tests/fixtures/fonts/RobotoSlab-subset.ttf`, Apache License 2.0, whose README there gives its provenance. The ink boxes the test expects were read from the render cache KiCad 9 wrote for the same texts on a KiCad 9 board.
